# React components

`@insighture/design-system` ships these components. Wrap the app in
`<InsightureProvider defaultTheme="light">` and import
`@insighture/design-system/styles.css` first (`references/web.md`). Read a
component's file for its props, variants and guidance before using it.

| Component | Category | File | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Button | Actions | `docs/Button.md` | The primary action control. Variants encode loudness, not colour. |
| IconButton | Actions | `docs/IconButton.md` | An icon-only control. Requires `aria-label` because there is no visible text to announce. |
| Avatar | Data Display | `docs/Avatar.md` | Represents a person or an organisation. Falls back from image to initials automatically. |
| Badge | Data Display | `docs/Badge.md` | A small status label. `tone` is semantic — it says what state something is in, not what colour you want. |
| Card | Data Display | `docs/Card.md` | A surface that groups related content. Compose with CardHeader, CardBody and CardFooter for the standard rhythm. |
| CardBody | Data Display | `docs/CardBody.md` | Main content region of a Card. Stacks its children with consistent spacing and absorbs the remaining height. |
| CardFooter | Data Display | `docs/CardFooter.md` | Action row of a Card. Right-aligns its children and adds a top hairline. |
| CardHeader | Data Display | `docs/CardHeader.md` | Title row of a Card, separated from the body by a hairline. Lays out as a space-between row, so a title and a trailing badge or action align correctly. |
| Tag | Data Display | `docs/Tag.md` | A categorical label — a topic, team or bucket. Unlike Badge, `color` is chosen for distinguishability, not meaning. |
| Alert | Feedback | `docs/Alert.md` | An inline message about the state of the system. Deliberately quiet: a neutral card whose only colour is the status icon and any action you pass. |
| Progress | Feedback | `docs/Progress.md` | A determinate progress bar. Omit `value` for an indeterminate sweep. |
| Spinner | Feedback | `docs/Spinner.md` | An indeterminate loading indicator for waits with no measurable progress. |
| Checkbox | Forms | `docs/Checkbox.md` | A single boolean choice, with optional hint text. |
| Input | Forms | `docs/Input.md` | Single-line text field. Owns its own label, hint and error, and wires the accessibility attributes for you. |
| Radio | Forms | `docs/Radio.md` | One option within a RadioGroup. Rarely used alone — the group injects `name` and checked state. |
| RadioGroup | Forms | `docs/RadioGroup.md` | A set of mutually exclusive options, wrapped in a fieldset with a legend. |
| Select | Forms | `docs/Select.md` | Native select with the design system’s field chrome. Pass `options`, or `children` when you need optgroups. |
| Switch | Forms | `docs/Switch.md` | An immediate on/off setting. Unlike a checkbox, it takes effect as soon as it is flipped. |
| Textarea | Forms | `docs/Textarea.md` | Multi-line text field. Same label/hint/error contract as Input. |
| InsightureProvider | Foundations | `docs/InsightureProvider.md` | Root of every Insighture surface. Sets the `data-ins-theme` attribute the token layer keys off, so any component rendered outside a provider is unstyled. Wrap the whole app in exactly one. |
| Divider | Layout | `docs/Divider.md` | A hairline rule, optionally with a centred label. Separates groups that are related but distinct. |
| Stack | Layout | `docs/Stack.md` | Flex layout primitive over the spacing scale. The default way to space anything — reach for it before writing a custom flex rule. |
| Tabs | Navigation | `docs/Tabs.md` | Switches between sibling views without leaving the page. Fully keyboard accessible: arrows move, Home/End jump, disabled tabs are skipped. |
| Modal | Overlays | `docs/Modal.md` | A focused dialog for a decision or a short task. Traps focus, restores it on close, locks body scroll, and closes on Escape. |
| Tooltip | Overlays | `docs/Tooltip.md` | A short hint on hover and on keyboard focus. Escape dismisses it. |
| Heading | Typography | `docs/Heading.md` | Section and display headings, set in DM Sans SemiBold. `level` sets the semantic tag and `size` sets the visual scale. They're deliberately independent, so the document outline stays correct however big something looks. |
| Link | Typography | `docs/Link.md` | Inline navigation. Underlined by default because underlines are how links are recognised. |
| Text | Typography | `docs/Text.md` | Body copy and every non-heading string. Carries the tone, size and weight scales. |
